subject: Post-demo recap & internal enablement: LumenHealth pilot path
body_messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@lumenhealth.com>, David Long <david.long@lumenhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@lumenhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap: LumenHealth discovery — next steps & stakeholders

Hi all — thanks for taking the time today. Quick consolidated recap for the internal team and next steps we promised to surface to Priya/Procurement: 

Call highlights (30-minute demo + discovery)
- Champion: Priya Shah (PM, Customer Data) is excited about prefix caching and model-compute cost savings for search/summarization workflows.
- Technical signal: David (CISO) flagged need for SOC 2 evidence, private VPC option, and data retention controls.
- Economic buyer: Theresa Kim (SVP Finance) is likely the primary approver for a first-year committed spend; she wants a clear 12-month TCO and pilot success metrics.
- Use case: 3-month pilot (20k monthly queries) for clinical note summarization + internal semantic search; success = 20% reduction in clinician time spent on triage workflows.

Immediate asks we committed to:
1) Internal: short champion enablement pack (one-pager + talk tracks) for Priya to take to Theresa — Marissa, can you draft?
2) Security: SOC2 artifacts and a short note on network isolation & KMS options — Ben to pull; David please confirm any additional ask.
3) Procurement: draft mutual action plan with milestones and billing cadence — Diego to prepare and share as a draft PDF for review.

Attachments: I will circulate a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a champion talk-track doc by EOD Friday.

Next steps / dates
- Internal sync (Marissa, Ben, Diego): Wed 8/4 10:00am PT (confirm)
- Share MAP + SOC2 stub with Priya by 8/6
- Target pilot kickoff: late August / first week September if procurement timeline holds

Priya, thank you again — sounding excited. If there are other stakeholders we should include (legal, procurement lead, Theresa), please loop them in.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0198
redwood.com

Diego — good notes. Quick draft of champion enablement content below (I'll attach a cleaner doc):

Champion one-pager (purpose: arm Priya for an exec sell-in) - Headline: "Reduce triage time by up to 20% with Redwood inference caching + tailored model profiles"
- Why now: clinicians are overloaded; search latency and token costs are blockers for scaling current in-house inference.
- Quick ROI bullets (to put in an email to Theresa):
  * Pilot cost: estimated $12k/month for 20k queries (post quantization, batching) vs. $38k for current cloud-hosted baseline — projected 68% unit-cost reduction.
  * 12-month projection: expect payback within 6 months post-rollout assuming 30% adoption across triage team.
  * Measurables: avg time-per-note, query throughput, cost-per-query.

Champion talk tracks (short):
- To Theresa (economic buyer): "This pilot is low-risk, with a measurable metric (clinician time) and a clear spend cap; procurement can start with a short-term reserved commitment to lock price for 6 months."
- To David (CISO): "We can run the pilot in your VPC with customer-managed KMS; we'll provide SOC2 artifacts and scoped controls for the pilot dataset."
- To procurement: "MAP outlines milestones and simple invoice cadence; we can accept PO + Net30 with a small initial deposit to reserve capacity."

I'll attach CHAMPION_TALK_TRACKS_v1.docx and a one-pager mockup. Ben — can you validate the cost numbers and the quick SOC2 artifact list before I send to Priya?

Marissa
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
